title: Why being the bigger person always backfires
hook: Being the bigger person is destroying your peace.
script: Being the bigger person is destroying your peace. You swallow your anger to keep the quiet. But silence is not peace to a manipulator. To them, silence is permission. True Stoicism is not enduring disrespect silently. It is choosing self-respect over fake harmony. Your silence never saved them, it trained them.

title: The Hard Truth About Why You Stay
hook: You stay because you love their potential.
script: You stay because you love their potential. They showed you a glimpse of gold once. Now you accept dirt just to see it again. Stoics teach us to accept cold reality. Stop mourning the version they faked. They did not change; they just stopped pretending.
